The fly in your soup is that Warner Oland, considered by not a few film critics as the best Charlie Chan of the series, was part East Asian on his mother's side. Oland's mother was in fact Russo-Mongolian; his father was Swedish. Thus, whereas Keye Luke was Cantonese, born in Guangzhou, China and raised in Seattle, Oland was one-fourth Mongolian and born in Sweden.…
